lines.zh: 我贴着水底滑，鳍像凿子。
lines.en: I glide along the bottom, fins like chisels.

lines.zh: 壳在背上，撞到石头也不怕。
lines.en: Shell on my back, I don't fear the rocks.

lines.zh: 我游过一片珊瑚，它们缩了。
lines.en: I swim past a patch of coral and it retracts.
The water parts for me with a thin sound.
One flick of my tail carries me far.
Legs paddle beneath me, treading nothing.
I squeeze through the seam of the seagrass.
Shallow light falls on my shell.
My plates shine underwater.
I swim toward the shadow on the shore.
The current quickens and I lower myself.

lines.zh: 我绕过沉船，木头已经烂了。
lines.en: I round a wreck; the wood is rotted.
Every stroke lifts a little sand.

lines.zh: 我在水下，比在岸上快得多。
lines.en: I'm far faster in water than on land.
I pass along the bottom of your boat.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但我一直在来。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I keep coming.

lines.zh: 我伏在石缝里，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I lie in a rock crevice, eyes only.

lines.zh: 有东西在壳上爬，我不理。
lines.en: Something crawls on my shell. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我翻动碎石，找藏着的蟹钳。
lines.en: I turn over rubble, looking for a hidden claw.
Bubbles rise in strings.
I work my pincers to test them.
The seawater here is a little fresh.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉到沙里，藏住壳。
lines.en: I settle into the sand and hide my shell.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼从我面前过去。
lines.en: A small fish passes in front of me.

lines.zh: 我数着水波，一个接一个。
lines.en: I count the ripples, one after another.
I'm not moving, but I'm listening.
The coral on my shell grows very slowly.

lines.zh: 我在水底，觉得自己很沉。
lines.en: On the bottom I feel very heavy.
A boat above; the oars are steady.
I open my mouth and taste the water.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我在水下，看着你。
lines.en: You're on the shore; I'm below, watching.

lines.zh: 影子一进水，我的钳就张开。
lines.en: As your shadow enters the water, my claw opens.

lines.zh: 我认得这种站姿，是猎物。
lines.en: I know that stance. Prey.
You step back and I come forward a little.
This shell of mine doesn't bite well, does it?
Come into the water. I'll wait.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，长在壳的边上。
lines.en: My eyes sit at the edge of my shell.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石，只露出一只眼。
lines.en: I press against the reef, showing one eye.

lines.zh: 水面垂下的手指，看着像饵。
lines.en: Fingers dangling over the water look like bait.
This river belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 螺壳碎了一角，我缩进缝里。
lines.en: A corner of my shell breaks; I shrink into the crack.
I pull into my shell and stay there.

lines.zh: 凿石者的小钳，被砸得发麻。
lines.en: My stonecutter claw goes numb from the blow.
The pain makes my pincers let go.

lines.zh: 这一下，打断了我的动作。
lines.en: That broke my rhythm.
I back into the deep, slowly.
One of my plates has come off.

lines.zh: 护甲裂开，血丝顺着鳃飘。
lines.en: My armor cracks and blood trails from my gills.
I press to the rock wall and stay still.
The seaborn will remember this.
The smell of flesh.
What's in your hand is dripping.
I rise a little. Just a little.
Drop it. I'll catch it.
That smells stronger than fish.
I can chisel stone under the sea.
You hold it up. I'll wait.

lines.zh: 水纹一圈圈往你那边去。
lines.en: The ripples are circling toward you.
Set it down and step back three paces.
Now that I've smelled it, I won't leave.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的靴子上，滑开。
lines.en: I bump your boot and slide off.
Shell against shell, a dull sound.
I back off and muddy the water.
That one, my shell took it.
You stepped on me. I was underneath.
The shove flips me over.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，从你腿间过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and pass between your legs.
Hard against hard, I don't lose.
The surface breaks white where I struck.
After the bump I sink again.
Another stonecutter, behind the reef.
We touch pincers.

lines.zh: 它在石上刮出一块平地。
lines.en: It scrapes a flat patch on the stone.
The eggs will stick to that stone.
We guard it, one on each side.

lines.zh: 它的壳比我旧，花纹也深。
lines.en: Its shell is older than mine, the patterns deeper.
We make no sound, only shift.

lines.zh: 这一窝，会有一半活下来。
lines.en: Half of this brood will live.

lines.zh: 水冷的时候，我们靠得近。
lines.en: When the water cools we stay close.
This is the seaborn way.

lines.zh: 我用钳子夹住，送进嘴里。
lines.en: I grip it with my pincers and bring it to my mouth.
This meat is a bit tough.

lines.zh: 碎骨片和螺壳，我塞进石缝。
lines.en: Bone shards and shell, I stuff them into a crack.
I eat the bone fragments too.
I clamp down and don't let go.
This mouthful has sand in it.

lines.zh: 沉下去的东西，都是我的。
lines.en: Whatever sinks down here is mine.
Two bites and it's down.

lines.zh: 壳里还有一点，我刮干净。
lines.en: There's a little left in the shell; I scrape it clean.

lines.zh: 吃完我把钳子在沙里擦了。
lines.en: Afterward I wipe my pincers in the sand.
Footsteps on the water's edge.
That shadow has stopped.
I press myself as low as I can.
I can see its ankles.
My stonecutter claw reaches even through water.
It hasn't noticed me underwater.
I take the shallowest route.
Behind the stone. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我把钳子收起来，先不响。
lines.en: I fold my pincers in, quiet for now.
It moves, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我跟着那道影子，一寸一寸。
lines.en: I follow that shadow, inch by inch.
It's stepped into the water.
The surface parts; I keep to the bottom.
Its feet are right above me.
I'll wait until it's deeper.
The water's murky. It can't see me.
I open my pincers and raise them slowly.
One more step and it's in my spot.
It stops, and I stop.
Even better. I'm in no hurry.
My pincers clamp and wrench down.
I ram its leg with my shell.
That one opened a line.
It pulls free and I retreat behind the stone.
The water reddens and I smell it.
I clamp again, harder.
It kicks and I roll over.
I hold on with my teeth, shell braced.

lines.zh: 钳子一夹，我退回石缝守着。
lines.en: My claw pinches once, then I retreat to my crack.
I sink back to the bottom and wait.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，壳上还带泥。
lines.en: I come up out of the sand, mud on my shell.
I know these waters.
First I test the current.
The coral on my shell hasn't grown in yet.
I flick my tail and head deeper.
Light on the shore, and it isn't moonlight.

lines.zh: 我听见了木头被凿的声音。
lines.en: I hear wood being chiselled.
The seaborn will keep coming.
First I'll learn this stretch of water.

lines.zh: 石头底下有个洞，正合适。
lines.en: A hole under the rock. Just right.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我只能往泥里钻。
lines.en: The water burns; all I can do is dig into the mud.

lines.zh: 我从水口摔下去，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from a ledge and land on my shell.
I'm dragged out of the water and my gills are drying.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，我被掀出水面。
lines.en: A muffled blast throws me clear of the water.
An arrow pierces my fin; I sink into the sand.
Cold light seeps into a crack in my shell.

lines.zh: 水里没有能吃的东西了。
lines.en: There's nothing left to eat in this water.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身都麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and numbs me all over.

lines.zh: 没有水，也没有底，我一直落。
lines.en: No water, no bottom. I keep falling.
